module.Title: Read the Temperature
module.Teaching: Python stores decimal sensor readings as float values. A decimal point makes this reading a float.

module.DebugPrompt: Quotation marks would make the reading text instead of a number.

module.TransferPrompt: Create humidity with the numeric value 47.8.
